messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Von Mises RNG
parts:
I have a varying intercept/slope hierarchical model with multiple data points per subject. I am trying to infer the per-subject parameters in order to predict a new outcome data set per-subject. I am taking the output of the model parameter inference and then essentially re-running the model in the generated quantities block with generated data for each subject. I use the "_rng" functions to apply the prior to my independent variable generated data. I have a Von Mises prior on one element of the data, and I would like to have the same "prior" on the fake generated data - I was looking for a von_mises_rng function. 

Is there a way I could work around this limitation?

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Von Mises RNG
parts:
If the quantities are continuous, you can declare them as parameters
rather than as generated quantities. Then they just get sampled
using MCMC with everything else. It's not as efficient, but it's
more general.

WE should add the von Mises RNG --- looks like some work, but
Peter should be able to handle it.

- Bob
